import pandas as pd

# Read the raw data
input_file = "outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv"
output_file = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"

# Read the input CSV
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Define the required columns
city_id = "city_id"
city_name = "city_name"
year = "year"
indicator_id = "indicator_id"

# Identify unique city identifiers and years
unique_city_ids = df[city_id].unique()
unique_years = df[year].unique()

# Create a mapping of city_id to city_name
city_name_map = df[city_id].map(lambda x: x).to_dict()

# Iterate through each city and year
for city_id in unique_city_ids:
    for year in unique_years:
        # Get the indicator values for this city and year
        indicator_values = df.loc[df[city_id] == city_id, indicator_id].values
        
        # Create a row for this city-year indicator combination
        row = {
            city_id: city_id,
            city_name: city_name_map.get(city_id, "Unknown"),
            year: year,
            indicator_id: indicator_values[0]  # Assuming one indicator per row
        }
        
        # Append to output dataframe
        output_df = pd.DataFrame([row])
        output_df = output_df.append(output_df, ignore_index=True)

# Write the output CSV
output_df.to_csv(output_file, index=False)

print(f"Matrix written to {output_file}")
